openQuestions.question: Does the terminal test's exact output mean visible prompt text? Existing readline emits ANSI cursor controls and echoes the answer, so raw output cannot equal the specified plain string while remaining byte-identical.

openQuestions.conservativeChoice: Preserved terminal behavior. Asserted the exact visible prompt after stripping control bytes, plus raw byte equality against the previous print-then-confirm behavior.
